turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale. Who decided to put a zero in the gradebook, and why didn't anyone call me first?
I'll stand, thank you. You haven't answered me, Hale: who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
We haven't spoken on the phone, Hale. Nobody called me, which is the problem. Who decided on the zero?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
Don't manage me, Hale. The zero stands for exactly as long as it takes me to walk upstairs to the principal. Withdraw it, or tell me what you actually have.
